title: Pilobolus editorialAim: prefer remembered image over unsourced stats
description:
## Intent

Limatus PR #15 added optional `editorialAim` and `compare.hardConstraints`. Pilobolus should state: when a statistic and a plain image compete, prefer the sentence a non-technical reader will remember. Empty `compare.hardConstraints` so dropping unsourced numbers is not a rank-1 DQ.

Scan still flags missing attribution. Do not turn off that check.

## Change

`publications/pilobolus/style-profile.yml` only:

editorialAim: When a checkable statistic and a plain image compete, prefer the sentence a non-technical reader will remember. Numbers that need a footnote more than they serve the scene should be cut or said in ordinary language. Link a source in the sentence when a figure stays.

compare:
  hardConstraints: []

## Out of scope

Limatus core. Other publications. Applying to published articles.
